resources.string: A lock that will not advance is in one of four states: the reciter has not reached the next ayah yet (next coverage below %1$s), the gate is shut so nothing is reaching the decoder, the coverage sits between the advance and decay thresholds so no branch can fire, or the recogniser is hearing a reciter other than the one the model was trained on.
No events yet — start a recitation.
Missing engine files — push them via adb (commands on each row), then restart recitation.
Mic delivers near-silence — check gain, distance, or another app holding the mic.
Mic stream frozen — stop and start recitation again.
Gate hears silence — the %1$s gate is closed, so nothing reaches the decoder. Recite louder.
No ayah matched yet — recite the locked ayah clearly.
